log.wasmFailed: The stream engine failed to start. Reload the page.
auth.help: Sign in to load your consoles and settings on any device.
auth.helpRegister: Create an account to save your consoles and settings.
account.title: Account settings
account.needCurrent: Enter your current password to save changes.
account.deleteHelp: This permanently deletes your account, consoles and settings.
share.title: Share stream
share.help: While you stream, people with the link receive video, audio and, if you allow it, the virtual pad or a physical gamepad. You can block buttons for both. The viewer virtual pad uses your theme.
share.vpadKeysHelp: Unchecked buttons are blocked for viewers, on the virtual pad and on a physical gamepad.
share.guest: You are watching a shared stream.
share.missing: This share link is no longer active.
share.needStream: Video/audio sharing starts when you launch a stream.
share.keywordsHelp: Several words: separate them with a comma, a semicolon or a new line (e.g. Help, password). If a word appears on screen, sharing pauses.
share.keywordDelayWarn: Your own game stays live. Viewers are a few seconds behind: a frame is sent only after the screen was checked with no keyword, so pause happens before they see the word.
share.keywordIdle: Enable sharing and start a stream to watch for keywords.
vpad.hint: The on-screen virtual pad is toggled from the stream toolbar. Place its buttons and adjust transparency in the full-screen editor.
vpad.themeHelp: Choose a supplied skin. In the layout editor you can also assign your own image to each button.
vpad.customIdle: Select a button to assign a custom image.
vpad.editorHelp: Drag a button to move it. Use the corner handle or the mouse wheel to resize. The editor matches the stream at 1:1.
help.title: Documentation
defaultsHint: * Defaults in () to right of value or marked with (Default)
consoles.hint: Registered and discovered consoles. Each can have its own PSN Account ID (base64). Hidden consoles stay hidden until you show them again.
consoles.empty: No consoles yet. Connect Chiaki Home Proxy or add a console.
keys.trackpadHint: Trackpad mode keeps macOS pointer acceleration, multiplies motion by the boost and makes small swipes count for more. Press F8 twice after toggling it.
keys.mouseHint: Click the video to lock the cursor in keyboard/mouse mode. The virtual pad keeps the cursor free. F8 toggles lock by default.
keys.hint: Click a cell, then press a keyboard key or a mouse button.
controllers.hint: The first PlayStation / standard Gamepad API controller is used (DualShock / DualSense). After plugging it in, press any button — no page reload needed.
config.hint: LAN Remote Play only. PSN / holepunch is not available in the WASM build.
config.hintHome: Chiaki Home Proxy relays traffic to your console. No router ports to open.
config.proxyHelp: By default, this page’s local proxy is used (its address is not shown). Custom lets you set another WebSocket URL (ws:// or wss://).
config.proxyBad: Invalid URL. Use ws:// or wss://.
config.proxyIpNotUrl: That looks like the console’s IP, not a proxy URL. Keep Proxy on Default, then add the console (+) with this address.
config.homeProxyOn: Connected via Chiaki Home Proxy. Traffic goes through your PC, with no router ports to open.
config.proxyApproveText: A Chiaki Home Proxy ({name}) wants to relay traffic to your consoles. No router ports are opened.
config.proxyDlHelp: Download it, run it on the PC next to your console, then sign in with this account. No router ports to open.
config.proxyDlMissing: No build published for this platform yet.
config.psnHelp: Default PSN Account ID (8-byte base64) for new PS5 registrations. Each console can also have its own ID in the Consoles tab.
add.title: Add a PlayStation
add.homeHint: Connected via Chiaki Home Proxy. Enter the console’s LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.1.70).
add.homeHintPending: Approve Chiaki Home Proxy first, then test the console’s LAN IP.
add.portcheckNeedHome: This LAN address is only reachable via Chiaki Home Proxy. Run it on the PC next to the console, sign in with this account, then click Approve.
add.portcheckNeedApprove: Approve the Chiaki Home Proxy connection first, then test again.
add.portcheckOkHome: TCP 9295 is reachable via Chiaki Home Proxy (no NAT forwarding needed).
add.portcheckWarn: TCP 9295 is not open. Forward it (NAT / firewall) then test again.
add.portcheckWarnHome: The console is not reachable from the Chiaki Home Proxy PC (LAN).
add.portcheckNeedTest: TCP 9295 must pass before adding the console.
add.name: Name (optional)
regist.title: Pair your PlayStation
regist.help: On the console: Settings → Remote Play → Add Device. Enter the PIN shown there.
regist.psnHelp: Use the PSN username signed in on this console. Find its account ID below — no password needed.
confirm.hideText:
Are you sure you want to hide this console?

Note: You can unhide from the Consoles section of the Settings under Hidden Consoles
confirm.deleteText: Are you sure you want to delete this console?
disconnect.title: Disconnect Session
disconnect.text: Do you want the Console to go into sleep mode?
keycap.title: Key Capture
keycap.help: Press a key for the keyboard. Click inside the Mouse box for a mouse button or the wheel. × to remove.
keycap.helpKb: Press a keyboard key. Delete to clear.
keycap.helpMs: Click a mouse button or use the wheel. Delete to clear.
pin.title: Login PIN
pin.help: Enter the PIN displayed on the console.
host.foreign: This console is already linked to another account.
log.hevcFallback: HEVC is not supported in this browser, falling back to H264.
log.webcodecsMissing: WebCodecs is unavailable in this browser.
log.psnHint: PS5 registration needs a valid PSN Account ID (look up your username or paste the base64 ID).
log.psnUserRequired: Enter a PSN username to look up.
log.connectFailed: Unable to connect to the console.
log.wakeTimeout: Console did not wake in time, trying to connect anyway.
quit.2: Session request failed (console may be in rest mode)
quit.4: Remote Play is already in use on the console
quit.5: Remote Play crashed on the console
log.registIpv6: IPv6 is not supported. Use the box public IPv4 (e.g. 82.x.x.x), not a 2a01:… address.
log.registRunning: Pairing in progress… searching for the console.
log.registSearchFail: No pairing response from the console. Reopen Pair Device / Link Device on the PS5 (Add Device on PS4), leave the fresh code visible, and try again. Being powered on alone is not enough. If it still fails, check that Remote Play is enabled for the active console user and the proxy PC can reach UDP 9295. For an offline or jailbroken account, console-side Remote Play activation may be required.
log.registLanHint: PIN pairing must be done on the LAN (192.168.x.x). Then add the console with the public IPv4 and the Regist / Morning keys.
log.proxyDown: Local proxy unreachable. Run: node wasm/proxy/server.mjs
log.insecureOrigin: This origin is not a secure context: WASM threads need HTTPS or localhost. Open {url} and accept the certificate.
log.isolationMissing: Browser isolation is unavailable. The server or reverse proxy must send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp. Reload after fixing these headers.
log.wasmMissing: This browser does not support WebAssembly. Open the client in a browser with WebAssembly enabled.
setup.intro: Turn on your console and connect it to the same network as this PC. No pairing keys needed.
setup.addressHelp: Where do I find the address?
setup.importHelp: Only use this if you saved keys from another Chiaki installation. Otherwise leave these empty and continue to PIN pairing.
setup.sameNetwork: Keep the console on and use its local network address for first-time pairing.
setup.lookupPrivacy: Your public username is sent automatically to a third-party lookup service after you pause typing. PSNTools is available as a manual fallback.
setup.pairPs5: On your PS5: Settings → System → Remote Play. Turn on Enable Remote Play, then choose Pair Device (or Link Device) to display your pairing code.
setup.pairPs4: On your PS4: Settings → Remote Play Connection Settings. Turn on Enable Remote Play, then choose Add Device to display your pairing code.
setup.accountReady: Account ID ready. Enter the pairing code shown on your console.
setup.lookupFailed: Automatic lookup is unavailable or no account was found. Open PSNTools below and paste its base64 account ID, or enter an existing ID manually.
setup.selectConsole: Select your console to fill in its address.
setup.addressPs5: PS5: Settings → Network → Connection Status → View Connection Status. Use the IPv4 address.
setup.addressPs4: PS4: Settings → Network → View Connection Status. Use the IP Address.
setup.discoveryOff: Discovery is disabled in Settings. You can still enter your console’s IP address below.
setup.noneFound: No consoles found yet. Check that yours is on and on the proxy PC’s network, or enter its address below.
setup.badKeys: Enter both saved keys. The registration key must be 32 hex characters or up to 16 ASCII characters; the RP key must be 32 hex characters.
setup.badPin: Enter the full 8-digit pairing code shown on the console.
setup.directPairing: The pairing search timed out. Trying a direct connection to the console…
pc.hint: WASD move · mouse look · left/right click fire/aim · Space jump · Shift sprint · Ctrl/C crouch · R reload · E interact · F8 unlock cursor. Click the video to capture input. Controller emulation: game dead zones and turn limits still apply. Custom bindings return when disabled.
quality.hint: 1080p, 60 fps, H.265, 50,000 kbps and mild GPU sharpening. Restart the stream to apply bitrate changes.
setup.badUsername: Enter a PSN username with 3–16 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, beginning with a letter.
controls.title: Controls
connection.title: Connection stopped
video.legacyPreset: Legacy render presets are unavailable in this browser renderer. Use Stream → Sharpening and Noise reduction.
connection.hint: Close any other Chiaki, Remote Play, or browser stream using this console, then try again. The console must stay on with Remote Play enabled.
controls.tip: Press ` again to hide this panel. F8 releases the cursor. Change bindings in Settings → Keyboard & mouse.
controls.custom: Your current keyboard and mouse bindings
controls.mouseLook: Move mouse to steer the configured stick
ls.title: Frame generation with Lossless Scaling
ls.mode: Prepare stream for external Lossless Scaling
ls.help: Keeps new streams windowed. Launch Lossless Scaling, select LSFG Fixed ×2 (60 → 120 displayed fps), then activate capture on the browser window using its configured hotkey. Start with scaling Off if you only want frame generation.
ls.limit: External Windows app required. Generated frames can improve visual smoothness but add GPU load, latency or artifacts. The console stream and input rate are unchanged; this switch does not start or confirm LSFG.
ls.status: Lossless Scaling mode is prepared. Activate LSFG in the external app; its active state cannot be read here.
quality.fogHint: Fog preset: 80 Mbps H.265, 10% sharpening, 45% edge-aware spatial noise reduction. No temporal blending or extra frame buffering. Higher noise reduction can soften fine detail. Restart for bitrate changes; press ` for received video Mbps. The console uses variable bitrate and can send less than requested.
quality.statsWaiting: Video statistics appear when frames arrive.
quality.stats: Requested {target} Mbps · received video {actual} Mbps · decoded {fps} fps · {width}×{height} · unrecovered lost frames {lost}. Live sample; excludes network overhead.
quality.limit: 0 disables sharpening. Enlarging a 1080p stream on a 1440p/4K screen cannot restore native detail. Avoid stacking this with Lossless Scaling sharpening.
keys.mouseTuning: Match compensation to your game's right-stick dead zone; lower it if aiming jumps. Set the game's aim acceleration to minimum. Motion stops within 24 ms; controller turn-speed limits still apply. PC mode: B = PS, N = Share.
quality.sourceHint: Source preset: 1080p60 H.265 at 40 Mbps, hardware decoding, no sharpening or denoising. Keeps original stream detail with less GPU work. Restart the stream after selecting it. Turn off external frame generation while diagnosing stalls.
quality.pipeline: Decoder: {pending} pending · last {ms} ms · resyncs {recoveries} · skipped {skipped}.
